english.title: Political parties - treasurer fail to deliver donation report within 7 days

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: POLITICAL PARTIES ELECTIONS AND REFERENDUMS ACT 2000

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the treasurer of a registered party, namely **(..SPECIFY PARTY..), failed to deliver to the Electoral Commission a donation report under Section 63 of the Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000

(A)_[within the period of seven days beginning with the end of the reporting period to which it related]_
(B)_[within the period of seven days beginning with the first day on which the party had a candidate at a general election, namely **(..SPECIFY..), where Section 63(1) of the Act applies to the party by virtue of Section 64(5)]_
english.legislation:
Contrary to section 65(3) of and Schedule 20 to the
Political Parties, Elections and Referendums Act 2000.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
